description: This file contains the implementation of CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) algorithms, including functions for computing, extending, unextending, and concatenating CRCs, specifically for CRC sizes from 8 to 128 bits. It defines classes such as CRC and CRC32, and includes internal functions and tables for optimized CRC calculations.

classes.name: CRC
classes.description: Base class for CRC algorithms, providing interface methods and common functionality.

classes.name: CRC32
classes.description: Implementation of CRC algorithm optimized for 32-bit CRC calculations.

methods.name: CRCImpl::FillWordTable
methods.description: Fills a table used for CRC calculations based on the polynomial and last CRC value.

methods.name: CRCImpl::FillZeroesTable
methods.description: Fills a table used for extending CRCs with zero bits.

methods.name: CRC32::InitTables
methods.description: Initializes lookup tables for CRC computation.

methods.name: CRC32::Extend
methods.description: Extends a CRC value with additional bytes of data.

methods.name: CRC32::ExtendByZeroes
methods.description: Extends a CRC value by a specified number of zero bits.

methods.name: CRC32::UnextendByZeroes
methods.description: Reverses the extension of a CRC by zero bits.

methods.name: CRC32::Scramble
methods.description: Scrambles a CRC value for internal purposes.

methods.name: CRC32::Unscramble
methods.description: Unscrambles a CRC value to its original form.

methods.name: CRC::Crc32c
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of CRC with the standard CRC32C polynomial.

methods.name: CRC::Concat
methods.description: Concatenates two CRCs, accounting for the length of the second message.
